enriched_activities.desc: Lies on bed. Pulls blanket over body. Closes eyes. Breathes steadily. Turns to left side. Adjusts pillow. Turns to right side. Pulls blanket up. Remains asleep. Stirs slightly. Shifts legs. Continues sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and showering
enriched_activities.desc: Wakes up. Opens eyes. Sits up. Swings legs out of bed. Stands up. Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Uses toilet. Flushes. Turns on shower. Adjusts temperature. Steps into shower. Washes body. Shampoos hair. Rinses. Turns off shower. Steps out. Picks up towel. Dries body. Brushes teeth. Washes face. Turns off light. Walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast with Member 1 (toast, kettle tea) and packing a lunch bag
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to kitchen. Greets Member 1. Opens refrigerator. Takes out bread, butter, and eggs. Places bread in toaster. Presses toaster lever. Takes out kettle. Fills kettle with water. Turns on kettle. Takes out mug. Places tea bag in mug. Takes out plate. Butters toast. Eats toast. Drinks tea. Talks with Member 1. Opens refrigerator. Takes out lunch items. Places items in lunch bag. Zips lunch bag. Washes dishes. Dries hands.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the arts centre workplace
enriched_activities.desc: Picks up bag. Puts on shoes. Opens door. Walks out. Closes door. Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Checks phone. Bus arrives. Boards bus. Pays fare. Finds seat. Sits down. Looks out window. Checks phone. Gets off bus. Walks to arts centre. Opens door. Enters building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as arts administrator: emails, exhibition scheduling, meetings with artists
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to desk. Turns on computer. Logs in. Opens email client. Reads emails. Replies to emails. Opens calendar. Schedules meeting. Makes phone call to artist. Discusses exhibition details. Takes notes. Walks to meeting room. Meets with artist. Discusses artwork. Shakes hands. Returns to desk. Continues emails. Opens scheduling software. Coordinates with gallery. Attends team meeting. Presents ideas.

enriched_activities.activity: Lunch break, eating and walking nearby
enriched_activities.desc: Leaves office. Walks to nearby park. Sits on bench. Opens lunch bag. Takes out sandwich. Eats sandwich. Drinks water. Throws away trash. Walks around park. Returns to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as arts administrator: grant paperwork, gallery coordination, program planning
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at desk. Opens grant application. Fills out forms. Types information. Prints documents. Reviews grant guidelines. Calls gallery. Coordinates exhibition dates. Sends emails. Plans program schedule. Meets with colleague. Discusses budget. Updates spreadsheet. Saves files. Organizes paperwork.
Packs bag. Says goodbye to colleagues. Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Boards bus. Pays fare. Finds seat. Sits down. Checks phone. Gets off bus. Walks home. Opens door. Enters house.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner with Member 1 using the induction cooker and eating at the table
enriched_activities.desc: Greets Member 1. Washes hands. Opens refrigerator. Takes out vegetables and meat. Places on cutting board. Picks up knife. Chops vegetables. Turns on induction cooker. Pours oil into pan. Adds vegetables. Stirs with spatula. Adds meat. Adds seasoning. Covers pan. Sets table. Places plates and utensils. Serves food onto plates. Sits at table. Eats dinner. Talks with Member 1.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching TV with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to living room. Sits on sofa. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Changes channel. Watches news. Talks with Member 1. Laughs. Changes channel. Watches show. Puts feet on coffee table. Leans back. Continues watching.

enriched_activities.activity: Freelance illustration work at the desk using computer and monitor
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Turns on desk lamp. Sits at desk. Turns on computer. Turns on monitor. Opens illustration software. Picks up stylus. Draws on graphics tablet. Saves file. Opens reference image. Adjusts colors. Draws more. Checks email. Replies to client. Continues drawing. Saves again.

enriched_activities.activity: Sketching in sketchbook and reviewing client briefs under the desk lamp
enriched_activities.desc: Turns on desk lamp. Picks up sketchbook. Picks up pencil. Sketches outline. Shades drawing. Opens client brief. Reads brief. Takes notes. Sketches more. Erases. Adjusts lamp. Continues sketching. Closes sketchbook.

enriched_activities.activity: Night washing up and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Uses toilet. Flushes. Turns on tap. Washes face. Dries face. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Changes into pajamas. Turns off light. Walks out.

Walks to bedroom. Turns off desk lamp. Lies on bed. Pulls blanket over body. Closes eyes. Breathes steadily. Turns to side. Adjusts pillow. Remains asleep. Puts head on pillow. Falls asleep. Moves leg. Breathes deeply. Turns again. Pulls blanket. Continues sleeping.
